name: Alstone Textiles (India) Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1990, Alstone Textiles
 Ltd does trading in fabric and investment 
activities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company is in the business of supplying, 
trading and dealing in Textiles including 
Cotton, Woolen, Art Silk, Natural Silk, 
 Readymade Garments, Hosiery, Synthetics 
 Fiber and Fabric and Mixed Fabrics. Company 
 has also diversified into different businesses ranging from third-party product distributions 
to originating unsecured personal loans, 
 corporate loans, etc.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.33 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 3.49% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Earnings include an other income of Rs.5.43 Cr.
